role: Route one consumer-repository setup request to one focused child.
notes: The hub performs read-only inventory and routing. The selected child owns any authorized file write; tracker and vault mutations remain separate authority.

children.note: Focused setup tasks; vault and triage remain optional

pipeline: pin consumer repository, exact worktree, branch or detached state, HEAD, dirty-state ownership, instruction file, allowed paths, and authority
inspect current setup read-only; create no worktree and mutate no external system
route an explicit request directly, or ask F-S1 once when the setup target is ambiguous
hand exactly one child the pinned scope and current contents
child returns draft or applied diff, verification evidence, and unresolved external setup; then stop

forks.question: What should be configured now?
forks.recommended: Issue tracker for a new repo
